rows.question: Where do I report an absence?
rows.answer:
You can report a student absence at Vista Ridge High School by submitting an absence note or medical documentation. This can be done in two ways:

1. **Email:** Send the documentation from the parent/guardian's email address on file to VRHSattendance@leanderisd.org.
2. **In Person:** Hand deliver the absence note or medical documentation to the Attendance Office.

Please note that phone calls are not accepted for reporting absences. It's best to submit your absence note within two days after the student returns to school.

If you need to request early dismissal, use the separate email VRHSearlydismissal@leanderisd.org (preferably before 10:30AM). 

If you have further questions, feel free to ask or check the [Absence for students](https://www.leanderisd.org/attendance) page for more information. Have a great day!

rows.question: What is the student check-out policy?
rows.answer:
Here is the student check-out policy for Vista Ridge High School:

- A parent or guardian must come to the office, provide a photo ID, and check their student out in person.
- For their safety, students MUST sign in/out at the Attendance Window when they leave or return to campus.
- Phone calls for leaving early are NOT accepted.
- You should arrive at least 20 minutes before you need your student to be released, due to the high volume of requests.
- In-person early check outs after 2:45 pm will NOT be granted. After 2:45 pm, you must wait for normal dismissal.
- Emails sent before 10:30 AM can be used to check students out at any time later that day, provided your email address is already on file. Include your student's full legal name, ID#, grade, exact dismissal time, and reason for dismissal.
- Follow-up notes or emails documenting the reason for the absence are REQUIRED if you want the absence excused.

For more details, you can check the official page here: [How To Check Your Student Out Early](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhsattendance/student-sign-out).

Let me know if you have any more questions!
sources: How To Check Your Student Out Early

rows.question: How do I appeal an attendance decision?
rows.answer:
To appeal an attendance decision at Vista Ridge High School, you should:

1. Contact your assistant principal to discuss your situation and request an appeal form. The appeals process is for special circumstances, such as medical procedures or surgery.
2. The school has an hours owed appeals committee that meets regularly to review these requests.
3. For more details or to begin the process, reach out directly to your [Assistant Principal](https://sites.google.com/leanderisd.org/vrhs-assistant-principals-offi/home).

Remember, having documentation for excused absences (like doctor's notes) can provide a basis for an attendance appeal in significant situations outside of your control.

If you need the appeal form itself, contact your assistant principal as described above.

Let me know if you need help finding their contact information or have any other questions!

rows.question: How do I register for AP tests?
rows.answer:
To register for AP tests at Vista Ridge High School for the 2026-2027 school year, you need to complete two main steps:

1. Register with College Board (MyAP):  
- Go to https://myap.collegeboard.org/login and log in or create an account.
- Use the JOIN CODE from your AP teacher to enroll in each of your AP classes.
- Indicate your AP test status (“YES” if you plan to take the exam, “NO” if not) by October 28, 2026.

2. Register & Pay with Total Registration:  
- Create an account or log in at the [Total Registration Link](https://user.totalregistration.net/AP/441176).
- Complete all required registration steps through this website.
- Pay the exam fee: $85 per exam, or $27 per exam for students on free/reduced lunch.
- Complete payment and registration by October 28, 2026, to avoid late fees.  
   (Late fee: $40 per exam if registering October 28, 2026 – February 18, 2027.)

Visit the [AP Test Registration Info](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/ap-test-registration) page for more details and links.

Let me know if you have any other questions or need help. Good luck with your AP courses, Ranger!

rows.question: What do seniors need to do before graduation?
rows.answer:
Based on the information available for the Class of 2027, here’s what seniors at Vista Ridge High School need to do before graduation:

- Order a Cap and Gown: Seniors are required to order the Cap, Gown & Tassel Unit from Herff Jones. Ordering information and packets are provided at the senior meeting.
- Complete the FAFSA: Filling out the FAFSA is a high school graduation requirement. The FAFSA opens on October 1, and the priority deadline for most Texas universities is January 15.
- Clear Obligations and Hours: All obligations and required hours must be cleared before seniors can pick up their cap and gown.
- Attend Required Meetings/Events: Attend the senior meeting for graduation information and order packets.
- Follow Cap Decorating Guidelines: If decorating your cap, make sure to follow the Vista Ridge High School guidelines.
- Monitor Additional Deadlines: Be aware of university application deadlines if applying to college, and pay attention to further information about prom, Senior Scramble, and Senior SAIL.

If you need more specific details or personalized help, please check with the [Staff Directory](https://vrhs.leanderisd.org/directory) or visit the front office. Best of luck preparing for graduation, Ranger!

You can access your STAAR scores in two main ways:

**1. Through the LISD Home Access Center (HAC):**
- Log into your LISD Home Access Center (HAC). You can find the HAC here: [Home Access Center](https://www.leanderisd.org/homeaccess)
- At the top of the Home Access Screen, click on the Grades icon.
- Next to Report Card on the left hand side, click on Texas Test Scores.
- Your student’s results will appear, or you will be directed to click to go to the Texas Student Portal.

**2. Through the Texas Assessment Parent Portal:**
- Go to [texasassessment.gov](https://www.texasassessment.gov)
- If you have your unique access code (not your child’s school ID or social security number), enter that code, your child’s birthdate, and legal first name to sign on.
- If you don’t know the access code:
  - It may be on the front page of a previous STAAR report (a 6-digit number/letter code).
  - Or, click “How do I look up my access code?” and fill in the requested information (the PEIMS ID is most often the student’s social security number).
  - If you did not provide a social security number at enrollment, use the state issued ID number: S_________.

For step-by-step instructions and visuals, check out this resource: [STAAR Results Information (STAAR Results: How to Access Your Child's Scores VRHS)](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-FYpAMvoDN5DjGZD3ThvecRfWtAJCnss/view?usp=sharing).

If you have any trouble accessing your scores, you can reach out to the school's front office for help. Good luck, Ranger!
sources: Access Scores through the TEA Family Portal
